name: BepInEx
description: Uses Vortex's BepInEx support and installs plugins into BepInEx/plugins.

unityBuild.title: BepInEx build
unityBuild.placeholder: Which kind of Unity build is the game?

placeholders.bepinexInstall: {{gameName}} mods need [BepInEx](https://docs.bepinex.dev). Vortex downloads and installs it the first time you manage the game. It is listed on the Mods page like any other mod and has to stay enabled.

{{gameName}} mods need the IL2CPP build of [BepInEx](https://docs.bepinex.dev). Vortex shows a notification with a link while it is missing. Download the newest `BepInEx-Unity.IL2CPP-win-x64` build from the [bleeding-edge builds](https://builds.bepinex.dev/projects/bepinex_be), drop it on Vortex's Mods page, enable it and deploy.

features: Installs BepInEx plugins into `BepInEx/plugins`. A plugin that is already inside a `plugins` folder keeps its subfolders; from any other archive only the `.dll` files are installed.
Registers the game with Vortex's BepInEx support, which installs BepInEx itself as a mod.
notes: `BEPINEX` in `src/bepinex/constants.ts` holds the game's Unity build (`unityBuild`) and `architecture`, and `GAME.modsPath` is BepInEx's plugins folder. Check them for {{gameName}}.
